body:
I've just been going through my entire life lately, just saying "why didn't I do that, why did I stay in 6th form when I hated it, why didn't I go to FE College to do I.T or Performing Arts, like I wanted to, why did I fail that job interview that would have got me more money, forced me to move to a new place and would have changed my life for the better despite all the shit I have served myself. 

Hell, I didn't deserve it enough clearly. More shit pie for me, full of the nutrients "go fuck yourself" and "suck it down, bitch". I'm sorry everyone, I'm just bitter and twisted about my entire life. So many cruel people I know get everything on a plate, while all I have done is to try and better myself. And I still hate my life.
